scope: Training-only counterfactual on standalone Hey Nyx WAVs and two retained compact INT8 models.
hypothesis: Test whether detections require the acoustic tail near the independently identified terminal /s/.
selection: All previously audited standalone training clips ending in separate CTC k, s tokens with terminal mean argmax probability >= .5.
models_threshold_scope: Original failed validation fallbacks; unchanged and not eligible for deployment.

arms.before_s_support: fade to zero by 40 ms before the CTC s feature support starts; zero the rest
arms.after_s_support: fade to zero by 60 ms after that support ends; zero the rest

limits: A contextual CTC support window is not a human phonetic boundary.
Removing a suffix changes the waveform, not its original training label. This only diagnoses model behavior.
Uses known training recordings and original failed thresholds. It cannot estimate deployment recall or latency.
